summary.en: When a pretty girl hires Kogoro to help her find an old flame, it seems like a routine case. But when Conan finds out that the man she is looking for was responsible for the death of her fiancé, he realizes that romance is the farthest thing from her mind. What is she planning to do?

victims.name: Tatsuo Yamaguchi
victims.causeOfDeath: Car crash and explosion from gasoline
victims.causeOfDeathZh: 汽油引发车祸爆炸致死
